segments.text: Alright, let's get started. Today we need to lock the v0 scope for Notely and decide what ships first.
I think the transcript-to-MOM path is the core. If we can turn a transcript into a structured summary reliably, that's the whole bet.
Agreed. So decision one: v0 ships the transcript import path, and audio recording comes later.
One concern from my side: if Ollama isn't running, the whole pipeline fails. We should at least surface a clear error instead of hanging.
Good point, that's a real risk. Let's make the engine health-check the model runtime on startup.
Action item for me then: I'll wire the health check and a friendly error by Friday.
And I'll own the SQLite storage layer so meetings and generated MOMs persist locally. I can have a first cut next week.
One open question: which Qwen size do we default to? 4B feels right for a dev laptop but we should benchmark 1.7B too.
Let's default to qwen3 4B for now and revisit after we have real meeting transcripts to test against.
Great. So to summarize: transcript path first, health checks, SQLite storage, Qwen 4B default. Thanks everyone.
